# Reflected simplex parity guards have full active capacity one

This is a rigorous test of a proposed low-capacity/parity-witness mechanism.
Six small reflected guard fibers block every full own triangle facet, but
their actual active menus can be retargeted and have capacity ONE. Thus
counting blocked facets or reflected parity witnesses is not sufficient
to certify low full-menu capacity.

The cyclic uniform-simplex coupling used below is ALREADY archived in
`candidate 7030d072151a686b`
and the lattice-simplex-product sources. It is credited as a dependency,
not claimed as a new general coupling theorem. The new conclusion is the
two-triple active-menu retargeting and exact capacity for this guard family.

## 1. Actual seven-fiber body

Let T=conv{A,B,C}, where A=(2,-1), B=(-1,2), C=(-1,-1), V=|T|=9/2.
Let p_A=e1, p_B=e2, p_C=-e1-e2, so their sum is0. The complete base is

    P={0,+-p_A,+-p_B,+-p_C}.

Indeed its hexagonal hull is {|z1|<=1,|z2|<=1,|z1-z2|<=1}; its only
integer points are the displayed seven. Put sigma=1/100 and

    K_0=T,
    K_(+-p_j)=D_j=(1-sigma)v_j+sigma T, j=A,B,C,
    v=|D_j|=sigma^2 V.

These are the actual integer fibers of their canonical convex hull.
All six outer bases are exposed vertices, while the middle fiber remains
T because all D_j are contained in T. Every facet of T has shared positive-
length patches near BOTH of its vertices, supplied by the corresponding
reflected outer pairs. Thus the full own-cone isolation test fails on
every facet, and no entire own facet is free.

Use buffer-free outward uniform smoothing at sufficiently small h>0,
with the actual pooled covariance

    Sigma=[(1+6sigma^4)/(1+6sigma^2)] Sigma_T.

The unique deepest source is (0,0). To see that its base is0, its ordinary
middle contribution alone is2, while any outer exposed base can isolate
its small own fiber and has maximal depth O(sigma^2+h sigma)<2. Uniqueness
in the middle follows from the positive-width full-normal centroid
identity. Combined affine permutations of the triangle and the hexagonal
base preserve the family, so the unique middle source is fixed and equals0.

## 2. Exact ORIGINAL-MASS outside quota against every actual cap

Let X be uniform in T and let X_A,X_B,X_C be its cyclic barycentric
permutations. Each is uniform in T and their sum is0 pointwise. Then

    Z_j^+=(p_j,(1-sigma)v_j+sigma X_j),
    Z_j^-=(-p_j,(1-sigma)v_j+sigma X_j)

are couplings of the uniform laws on the two sign triples of outer fibers,
and sum_j Z_j^+=sum_j Z_j^-=0 pointwise in FULL physical space.

For every closed halfspace through0, at least one point in each coupled
triple belongs to it. Since the outward profile equals1 at nonnegative
margin, the same statement gives sum_j Psi(margin_j/(h Gamma))>=1.
Integration with the equal original fiber volume v proves

    EVERY through-source smoothed cap has outside mass >=2v.       (1)

This is neither a count of transported copies nor a charge to a small
anchor. Each sign triple is integrated against its own uniform marginal
volume, and the two triples are disjoint original fibers. It therefore
avoids the coincident-image/anchor problem of the old parity forests.

## 3. Actual canonical minima and exact retargeting

For sufficiently small h the own triangle has exactly its three canonical
minimizing directions u_A=(1,0), u_B=(0,1), u_C=(-1,-1). The elementary
angular formula and strict-gap proof are already in Section6 of
`candidate f8d3ad8252b089e8`;
the covariance here is a scalar multiple of Sigma_T, merely rescaling
the effective width. Their norms Gamma(u_j)=g are equal.

Let q_h be that own smoothed minimum. With base tilt0, cap u_j captures
both fibers of its matching pair completely and the other four not at all,
so its mass is q_h+2v. Combining this with (1) shows that these are ACTUAL
global minimizing caps at the deepest source, with common budget

    Q=q_h+2v.                                        (2)

Choose a fixed large finite L, for example L=10, and make the following
actual replacements of their base tilts:

    cap A: a_A=(0,0),
    cap B: a_B=(L,-L),
    cap C: a_C=(L,0).

At sufficiently small h their exact saturated outside captures are

    A: {+p_A,-p_A},
    B: {+p_A,-p_B},
    C: {+p_A,-p_C}.

All containments/exclusions have fixed positive margins. Each replacement
therefore still has outside mass2v and remains ACTUALLY active by (2).
All smooth section coarea is in the middle triangle, and those three own
coareas are equal. Hence the quantile AND response menu weights are1/3.
The normalized continuous normals still sum to0.

Thus this active balanced menu captures the ENTIRE exposed fiber +p_A
in every term. The nonnegative convex physical field

    Phi(n,z,x)=[2z1-z2-1]_+

is positive only on that measured fiber (value1 there,0 on the other six).
Its menu capture efficiency is exactly1. As every profile is at most1,
the full active capacity is exactly

    c_0=1.                                           (3)

The argument retains actual common budgets and the full normal balance;
it does not retarget a merely tied but nonminimizing cap.

## 4. Implications and limits for global reciprocal capacity

The three reflected pair directions have the three unused parity classes
(1,0),(0,1),(1,1). Although they geometrically block all own facets, they
are not unpaid witnesses: their joint original-mass coupling creates
alternative paying menus. A low-capacity witness theorem must exclude
this retargeting or keep its credit; it cannot count the guard pairs alone.

For reference, hinge c_i>=1/(d+1) and paying c_i>=Gamma_d imply in d=2
that the proposed reciprocal-capacity bound is automatic whenever

    number of low sources <=3(2^n-number of all sources).

This is only bookkeeping, not the missing arithmetic theorem. The old
full-parity forest still supplies no injection into unused parities:
its valid midpoint inclusions can have coincident images and signed root
budgets, even with compatible convex bodies and common cap bounds.

No general inequality sum_i 1/c_i<=2^n/Gamma_d is proved here. The concrete
positive result is the exact capacity-one certificate (3), which shows
how an apparent three-parity obstruction disappears under full-menu
optimization.
